text:
I had to visit Dr. Pairat because of problems with my eye. I had a very positive experience. The ladies at reception are very nice and speak good English.
Dr. Pairat is very competent and examined it very carefully with modern equipment and explained the problem very well.
Waiting time was 15 minutes.
Price was appropriate
I am absolutely satisfied and can recommend the ophthalmologist to everyone.

My first time I have to visit a doctor in Thailand.
Right now I have an eye infection and dr.pairat diagnosed the problem straight away! I was waiting about 30 minutes untill I got my diagnosis and my medicine. Everybody is speaking great English, very polite and professional. Thank you Dr pairat and team <3

I have recently had my second cataract surgery by Dr Pairat, the first was about a month earlier. I cannot recommend Dr Pairat high enough, his explanation of the procedure was very detailed and in English. the aftercare was again very detailed, although I could not attend his clinic for an appointment, after the second surgery, due to a stomach complaint. I followed Dr Pairat's instructions as accurately as I could, so after the stomach complaint was over, I felt There was no need to take up the good Doctors time, as my second eye was fine. I strongly recommend if you have eye problems visit his clinic.

As for Pat David, it is obvious this person has not been in Thailand very long, and should keep his/her comments to themselves, the doctor is far from arrogant, a nice friendly chap!
Remember English is not the receptionists first language, but will be better than your Thai!

Dr.Pairat and his staff were excellent, he operated on my infected cyst the same day as first appointment. After a few days I was able to drive. The proceedure was carried out with great skill and for a very reasonable price. 6 days later I am.back in the UK and its healing well.
I am very grateful to Dr. Pairat for his great skill.
Dont hesitate to go if you have any concerns about your eyes. Be mindful of variable opening times and get there as early as possible

Our second visit to Dr. Pairat was today. If you are looking for an eye doctor in Hua Hin then he is an excellent choice. I am sure there are other good doctors here, too, but I can guarantee you will be happy with Dr. Pairat.

Not recommended, disgusting clinic, shoes off before you enter is revolting rules for a public place. It is not a surgery, just a consulting room. Receptionist helped to deal with patients who have hands like an elephant’s trunk.
Mr . Dr is arrogant. Can’t fly out of clinic quick enough.
unbelievable. they clos until March 3rd and don't update on Google. hiw ignorant can one be?

First class service with friendly helpful staff who have a command of English. No appointments needed as people are seen on a 1st come 1st serve basis. Clean environment and Dr Pairat takes great care to talk you through what might be wrong with your eye(s). He is also an eye surgeon as well as holding his Mon to Fri Consultation Clinic. Highly recommend to use this Clinic if you're in need of treatment.

My first visit to Khun Dr Pairat was almost 2 years ago. At that time, he diagnosed a cataract and glaucoma. The cataract was already very advanced, so an operation on both eyes was arranged promptly. Khun Dr Pairat's advice regarding the lenses was very sound and in line with the latest state of the art. Khun Dr Pairat carried out both operations at Bangkok Hospital with great care and absolute professionalism. Thanks to the choice of lenses, I can now see very well without glasses, both far and near.
Because of my glaucoma, I continue to have quarterly check-ups. My intraocular pressure has largely normalised.
I can recommend Khun Dr Pairat as an excellent doctor and a very likeable person. I feel that I am in the very best of hands with him.

I had lens replacement surgery on my eyes in Korea several years ago. The process was painful and left me almost blind for 2 weeks. Hence I was reluctant to have invasive surgery on my eyes again. I was buying increasingly more powerful spectacles to overcome the challenges I was having seeing my laptop, reading and any close up work.

This came to a head yesterday when I bought my 3rd pair of spectacles in as many weeks, that were again not entirely successful. Therefore I visited Dr. Pairat. He gave me a thorough examination and said he could repair the damage to my eye with laser treatment. He explained that it would be entirely painless and only take a few minutes. I agreed and true to his word, it was painless and quick and I had no difficulty driving home afterwards. After a nights sleep, I have no discomfort and am writing this on my phone, which would have been impossible previously.

Also not forgetting the ladies in the doctor's office. They all spoke excellent English, were friendly, professional and a credit to their profession and I thank them very much for making my visit so pleasant.

I  went to the clinic with high confidence because of  personal recommendation. My initial reaction was favourable because those waiting were predominantly Thai . I registered and my  distance vision was checked by the receptionist. Closing time at midday was approaching and I was asked to return another time to see the specialist. I was surprised to be charged "only 500 bahts" for this. No receipt was offered or given.
I returned the following day and saw the doctor.  He is very pleasant and competent and told me what I already knew about my eyes. I wanted to get some new prescription spectacles but sadly the testing equipment in his consulting room was not functioning. It was agreed that I would be contacted by phone when I should return. That was over two weeks ago, since when I have heard nothing. At this visit I was charged a further 1200 bahts, not excessive but equally I was told nothing more than i already knew.(again no receipt).
A really disappointing experience. I cannot recommend because I did not get the new properly prescribed specs which was the reason I went there. Is the main problem the receptionist, who seemed pleasant but is not really reliable?

Dr Pairat has been around and seen more than a few farangs that are after cheap and high quality service and staff that can explain any eye problem in English language or in the case of French farangs the use of graduate level French language - Germans naturally in high German language, not Bavarian. Preferably in an office surrounded by all the latest high tech equipment that can speak any language determined by AI and back-noised by digital gadgets and of course headsets for everyone. You are better off going back to Miami, London Harley street or Heidelberg.
I had work done at Dr Pairat for many years, including cataract surgery performed by him at the Bangkok Hospital, and found it very acceptable although the 'shoes off' and sitting there for an hour can sometimes feel a bit boring. That's what the neighbouring massage parlours are there for. Of course also no English and another 250 Baht gone. But that's OK!

Professional. Dr. Pairat diagnosed my son's lazy eye and had his first pair of glasses sorted within 3 days. Gave good advice on how to improve it so we fully understood the process and was patient with my questions. Was also ok with us outsourcing some frames to suit my son.

All in all a good experience which helped my son accept the fact he has to wear glasses all the time and eyepatch after school for the importance of his future sight.

Professional care, clean & decent English spoken.  We came to Dr. Pairat eye clinic because of this Google reviews.  We want to be sure the doctor office is capable of English/American standard of eye care like the US.  We are happy with the service.  My wife has 2 eye conditions, cataract & glaucoma.  We come to get the eye drops & check up every other months for the eyes.  The office provide English billing receipts for us to file insurance claims for the eyes condition.  I would recommend.

Seriously go somewhere else.  Terrible front desk staff who are rude and extremely unprofessional.  I wanted to leave straight after speaking with them but my wife convinced me to stay.  There is no appointment system offered, you just have to wait your turn (I waited over an hour) in a hot and uncomfortable waiting room.  Saw the Dr who told me what I already knew about my eye condition.  I wasn’t  in his company more than 5 minutes but was charged 500 baht.  For me it was a waste  of time and money.  There are much better options in Hua Hin that will treat you with respect, courtesy and humility whilst offering excellent value for money.

I was very impressed visiting this clinic. I suffered from contact lenses wearing complications. Dr.Pairat is very competent and helpful. He gave me some strict treatments and the outcome was very satisfied. I also made eye-glasses from him. The quality was excellent, comparable to what I got from Bangkok.

We were in Hua Hin on holiday when my son's overnight contact lens got stuck in his eye.  After much panic and pain, I found Dr. Pairat on Google and was sceptical at first but had didn't really have any options.  I was pleasantly surprised by the kind and helpful staff, and even more impressed by Dr. Pairat's professionalism and responsiveness.

Super grateful for him saving my son's eye!  Definitely recommend anyone in need to see him!

-------------------------------------------

Dr. Pairat, thank you so much for saving my eye.  I had a contact lenses in the morning I could not get it out so my dad helped me but the eye lens was already out but he didn't know so he was actually pulling my eye out.  It hurt so much,😭😭😭then I finally convinced my dad to bring me to this eye doctor . And he helped make my eye much better.,🙂. Michael 10 years old from Hong Kong.

I was having an issue with one of my eyes. I thought it might be another “floater” but it was more than that.
With some “prompting” from my friends they recommended I see Dr. Pairat at the Pairst Eye Clinic in Hua Hin for an eye examination.
I saw him the next day and after a thorough examination he advised me I had a detached retina!
As a guest to Thailand, going home for treatment was not an option given the urgency of the situation.
Dr. Pairat recommenced I attend a hospital in Bangkok for treatment purposes. He referenced a few hospitals, so after discussion with others who underwent eye treatment in Bangkok, I selected the Rutnin Eye Hospital.
That is where I underwent surgery to repair the damaged eye. The treatment and care I received at this hospital was superb.
Following discharge from the hospital I saw Dr. Pairat for checkup purposes.
Once again he conducted a thorough examination of my eye and recommended the desired treatment until I am able to return home and see my doctors there.
So thank you Dr. Pairat, along with the support staff at your Clinic, for the service you provided me. It was truly appreciated.
You may well have assisted in my not losing the sight in my eye.
i would not hesitate at all recommending your Clinic to others in need.
Many thanks for the service you extended me and may you enjoy continued success!
Kindest regards.

My husband and I and mother who is 87yrs old could not be more delighted with the professional care we received at this clinic. Mother had an eye infection caused by a dropped lower eyelid. She was referred for surgery when the infection cleared. Thank you so much to doctor and all staff who were so lovely to our mother
First time visit. Had a pain in my eyelid. Great service he spoke in English too! My wife and I will return to buy reading glasses.

I would like to thank the doctor for being clear and efficient in his work and communication. He speaks good English and acts professionally. The price is reasonable too.
The receptionists were polite and efficient.
I recommend this place.

I have been a client of Dr Pairat since he started in Hua Hin.  He has studied in very prestigious universities in USA and this shows in everything he does:  Best care and competency in Hua Hin as attested by scores of my friends in addition to myself.

You can't make appointments, not even when I explained that I would come with my elderly mother in law who has multiple health issues. The reception was very rude and hang up on me. Not a way to treat potential patients. I called on the the 11th of July just after 5 pm

I would like to thank Dr Paitat and is staff very efficient and explaining what was wrong and showing me and putting me at ease with my problem. Excellent service and would recommend to anyone who have eye problems.
Today I received excellent service from Dr Pairat and all of his staff.  It was a very thorough examination. Highly recommended.
Will reopen 1 May 2026

Location : very good , close to Huahin Market Village

Place : Tiny and clean clinic with modern equipments

Doctor : Knowledgeable, English-spoken, really knows what he is doing

Staffs : Friendly, willing to help, partially English-spoken

Price : Good price when compared to other private hospitals
Excellent opthalmologist. Speaks good English, always explains things thoroughly and is happy to answer questions. All the staff are friendly and helpful.
So far extremely helpful, super busy, no appointment so first come, nevertheless a very competent optimist used by many.
Excellent Doctor.Had surgery on right eye , cataracts and damaged retina, vision restored 100%...now 20/20.Left eye next in line.
Very professional Dr. Pairat performed cataract surgery on my eye, excellent result.
Not the cheapest, but good, professional service makes it worthwhile.
Got new eyes here, best decision ever made!
Very professional, don't trust people here leaving negative feedback.  This guy is a professional.
Not recommended.  Staff are rude, poorly trained and unprofessional.
Highly recommended. Very professional.
Nice doctor
clinic has less equipment .
Not recommended for injuries
Professional ophthalmologist , speaks English, likable. I recommend.

Excellent ophthalmology practice. I arrived at 9 am without an appointment and received a very warm welcome. I was seen 20 minutes later by Dr. Pairat. He is very pleasant and takes the necessary time for the examination. In my case, it was a secondary cataract. He provided explanations, showed me photos, and explained the laser treatment. Since I was on a scooter, he advised me to return that same evening by taxi. I had the laser procedure that same evening. The price was very reasonable and the result... magical. A big thank you to the whole team. I highly recommend them.

The doctor is kind, polite, and highly skilled in specialized eye care. He provides excellent diagnoses and recommendations.
The clinic is clean, and the reception staff are welcoming (but you might feel …

Dr. Pairat's excellent reputation is well-deserved. My cataract surgery, despite severe myopia, was a resounding success. This specialist speaks English and takes the time to provide explanations and answer all your questions. You will be dealing with a very serious practitioner who is also friendly, approachable, and considerate. Flawless, a true professional.
Very professional and friendly service. I had an infection in my right eye; treatment and medication cost €50, which was very fair. …

I went to the doctor with an inflamed eye. After waiting about 40 minutes, it was my turn and I was examined.

I was asked several times if I needed a receipt for my insurance company, so it seems the reviews here were taken into account.

I was diagnosed with ocular herpes. The appropriate medication and instructions for use were provided immediately. (One of the medications is quickly absorbed, so it needs to be taken every three hours.)

The cost, including medication, was approximately €80, which is roughly the same as a private bill in Germany.

A week later, everything is fine again. Thank you very much, Doctor.
The place was clean, the service was fast and friendly. We were at the clinic for about an hour and during that time we saw the doctor and got the medicine. I can recommend 👍🏻 …

The doctor is skilled. The medication might be a little more expensive than elsewhere, but the treatment is effective and the patient recovers quickly. The doctor gives good advice and conducts thorough examinations. You can ask questions about your symptoms that are unrelated to the treatment but are welcome to do so.

I went there today for pain in my left eye, which had a myopia implant surgery in France in May. The doctor detected an infection and gave me antibiotics. I'm seeing him again in two days to have the stitches removed. He was very friendly, …

The doctor provided excellent service, provided thorough examinations, was very dedicated, and was friendly to his customers. The cost wasn't too expensive, especially since I'm currently studying. He was very understanding and encouraged me to save money, such as telling me I didn't need to get expensive frames.
Thank you. I will definitely use this service again.

text: I'm a doctor myself and suddenly developed photopsia, so I went to the doctor's office one morning. I was seen first thing without an appointment. The findings were confirmed in Germany. I've since undergone laser therapy.

Although the price is expensive compared to other clinics, the doctor provided excellent consultation and advice.
As for the staff, which many previous reviews mentioned as not being very good, it's true that those reviews weren't helpful. 😅 …
